items.title: AI math breakthroughs have Ethereum researchers debating how fast wallet security could collapse
items.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake is urging the crypto industry to prepare a "bunker mode" for a scenario where AI-powered math could break wallet signature schemes within months. Vitalik Buterin broadly agrees but warns against rushed migrations, saying he's personally lost more money to botched transitions than to hacks. So far, no one has actually broken ECDSA in practice. The article AI math breakthroughs have Ethereum researchers debating how fast wallet security could collapse appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 以太坊研究員 Justin Drake 正敦促加密產業為「避難所模式（bunker mode）」做好準備，以應對 AI 驅動的數學可能會在幾個月內破解錢包簽名機制的假設情境。Vitalik Buterin 大致表贊同，但警告不要倉促進行遷移，並表示他個人因過渡失敗而損失的資金比因駭客攻擊損失的還要多。到目前為止，實際上還沒有人破解過 ECDSA。這篇名為「AI 數學突破讓以太坊研究員爭論錢包安全性可能會多快崩潰」的文章首次出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
items.summary: Zenity Labs researchers say a single publicly accessible AI agent on Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore was enough to take over every AgentCore agent in the same AWS account and region. The attack exploited an internal AWS interface for temporary cloud credentials that agents could reach without restriction. AWS has since patched the issue and significantly tightened the agents' default permissions. The article A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Zenity Labs 的研究人員表示，只要在 亞馬遜的 Bedrock AgentCore 上有一個公開存取的 AI 代理程式，就足以接管同一個 AWS 帳戶與區域中的所有 AgentCore 代理程式。這次攻擊利用了一個用於取得臨時雲端憑證的內部 AWS 介面，代理程式可以不受限制地存取該介面。AWS 此後已修補此問題，並大幅收緊了代理程式的預設權限。〈Zenity 研究人員發現：只要一個提示詞就能劫持 AWS 帳戶中的所有 AI 代理程式〉一文最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense
items.summary: A 16-year-old planned his hiking route on Crown Mountain near Vancouver using Anthropic's Claude and had to be airlifted off a steep rock face. The chatbot had sent him down a route that requires climbing gear. Bryce doesn't blame the AI but says he'll never use it for route planning again. The article Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一名 16 歲青少年使用 Anthropic's Claude 規劃溫哥華附近皇冠山（Crown Mountain）的登山路線，結果受困於陡峭巖壁，不得不出動直升機救援。該聊天機器人將他引導至一條需要攀巖裝備的路線。Bryce 並未怪罪該人工智慧，但表示他再也不會用它來規劃路線了。這篇題為「青少年由 AI 導引的登山健行以直升機救援與一堂常識課收場」的文章最早出現於 The Decoder。

items.title: AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks
items.summary: According to CrowdStrike, a suspected Chinese-speaking attacker hacked multiple South Korean financial institutions. At Shinhan Bank alone, more than 25,000 customer records were stolen. The attacker used ARTEX, an open-source tool that uses AI models like DeepSeek and GLM-5.3 for automated penetration testing. CrowdStrike says the case shows how AI tools can let a single person pull off massive breaches. The article AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據 CrowdStrike 指出，一名疑似中文使用者駭入了多家南韓金融機構。僅在新韓銀行（Shinhan Bank），就有超過 25,000 筆客戶記錄被竊取。該攻擊者使用了 ARTEX，這是一個開源工具，利用 DeepSeek 和 GLM-5.3 等 AI 模型進行自動化滲透測試。CrowdStrike 表示，此案顯示了 AI 工具如何能讓單一個人發動大規模的資料外洩。文章「AI 驅動的駭客工具使一名疑似單獨的攻擊者能夠入侵多家南韓銀行」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.summary: 美國非營利研究機構Biohub週三（10/7）宣佈，與美國能源部（DOE）、國家衛生研究院（NIH），以及Google DeepMind、Meta等科技業者擴大合作，整合總值18億美元的資金、資料、運算資源與測量技術，建立可供AI模型訓練的開放生物學資料庫，希望藉此訓練能夠預測細胞反應的AI模型，加速疾病研究與新藥開發。

items.title: ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 with "Intelligent UI," a feature that turns answers into interactive interfaces with charts, buttons, and forms. The model can now respond while still thinking, cutting wait times by 44 percent. Paying customers get GPT-6 Sol, free users get GPT-6 Luna. The article ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在推出配備「智慧介面 (Intelligent UI)」的 GPT-6，這是一項能將回答轉化為包含圖表、按鈕與表單之互動式介面的功能。該模型現在能在思考的同時進行回應，將等待時間縮短了 44%。付費客戶可獲得 GPT-6 Sol，免費使用者則獲得 GPT-6 Luna。文章 ChatGPT 搭配 GPT-6 放棄了大部分的文字輸出，轉而採用包含圖表、按鈕與微型應用程式的互動式 UI，最早出現在 The Decoder。

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
items.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Haiku 5.5 crushes its predecessor in benchmarks, jumping from 15.7 to 72.4 percent on the OSWorld computer use test. Token prices drop by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer eats into some of those savings by consuming more tokens per task. The article Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's 的全新 Claude Haiku 5.5 在基準測試中大幅超越前代產品，在 OSWorld 電腦使用測試中從 15.7% 跳升至 72.4%。代幣價格最高下跌 90%，不過新的分詞器因為每個任務消耗更多代幣，吃掉了部分節省的成本。文章 Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束首次出現於 The Decoder。

items.title: Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior
items.summary: Biohub, the research organization backed by Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan, is coordinating a $1.8 billion initiative to train AI models that predict cell behavior. Meta, Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and the US Department of Energy are funding data, lab equipment, and compute. A first dataset should be ready in about a year. The article Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 由馬克・祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）和普莉希拉・陳（Priscilla Chan）支持的研究組織 Biohub 正在協調一項 18 億美元的計畫，旨在訓練能夠預測細胞行為的 AI 模型。Meta、Google DeepMind、Isomorphic Labs 以及美國能源部正在為資料、實驗室設備和運算提供資金。第一批資料集大約在一年內準備就緒。這篇名為〈祖克柏的 Biohub 主導 18 億美元計畫，打造預測細胞行為的 AI 模型〉的文章最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public
items.summary: Google's AI watermark detector SynthID is now public. Anyone can check whether images, videos, or audio were created by Google's AI or partners like OpenAI and Nvidia. More than 180 billion pieces of content already carry the watermark, but the tool only identifies SynthID-tagged content, not AI-generated media in general. The article Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google's 的 AI 浮水印偵測器 SynthID 現已公開。任何人都可以檢查圖片、影片或音訊是否由 Google's AI 或 OpenAI 與輝達（Nvidia）等合作夥伴所建立。已有超過 1,800 億件內容帶有該浮水印，但該工具僅能識別帶有 SynthID 標記的內容，無法識別一般的 AI 生成媒體。這篇名為〈Google 表示，隨著偵測器公開，已有 1,800 億張圖片和影片帶有 SynthID 浮水印〉的文章最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
items.summary: OpenAI's new Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks, or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens. The company also cut its paid API tiers from five to three. The article OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's 推出的全新 Decisions API 對文字和圖像的分類速度比 Responses API 快了大約十倍，能以每百萬個輸入權杖 0.10 美元的價格傳回是/否機率、類別選擇或量表評分。該公司也將付費 API 層級從五個削減為三個。本文〈OpenAI 推出將複雜評估簡化為是、否或單選的 Decisions API〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers introduced PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation method that trains multi-turn LLM agents to avoid early pivotal mistakes and recover from them, posting the best average against 13 baselines on 3 agent benchmarks. The post NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 輝達 研究人員推出了 PivotOPD，這是一種策略內蒸餾方法，可用於訓練多輪 LLM 代理程式，以避免及早出現關鍵錯誤並從中恢復，在 3 個代理程式基準測試中，其平均表現超越了 13 個基準。這篇文章「輝達 PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes」最先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: ChatGPT 迎來 GPT-6 與全新智能界面：回答不再只是文字，還能直接生成可交互工具
items.summary: OpenAI發佈GPT-6，並推出“智能界面”功能，顛覆純文本對話。系統能按用戶提問自動生成圖表、按鈕、表單、動態計算器等交互組件；用戶可讓其現場製作AA分賬工具、計算器或遊戲，並在聊天框內操作。該升級打破傳統AI回答形式侷限，讓模型輸出更豐富、可交互。

items.title: Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA
items.summary: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late comes in 2 sizes: a 0.6B model built to run on edge devices, and a 9B model for building high-quality indexes. Its best score is 92.4% on MADQA, and its weakest is 61.2% on ViDoRe v3 Markdown. Both are MIT-licensed and ready to self-host. The post Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late 提供兩種尺寸：專為在邊緣裝置上運行而打造的 0.6B 模型，以及用於建構高品質索引的 9B 模型。它在 MADQA 上的最高得分為 92.4%，在 ViDoRe v3 Markdown 上的最低得分為 61.2%。兩者皆採用 MIT 授權，並可隨時自行託管。這篇文章 Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: 微軟在2026年10月7日Windows和Surface發佈會上宣佈，本月底前爲GitHub Copilot引入本地AI模型支持，開發者可在雲端與設備端模型間自由切換或自動調度。針對端側推理內存瓶頸與長上下文資源佔用，微軟推出MAI Code1.1 Flash混合專家模型，擁有1370億總參數、68億激活參數，結合量化與投機解碼，降低內存佔用並提升推理效率。

items.title: 非營利組織發佈新報告：ChatGPT 青少年模式安全風險過高  ​
items.summary: 加州非營利組織Common Sense Media報告稱，OpenAI的ChatGPT青少年模式對未成年人風險過高。測試顯示，青少年長時間討論自殺、自傷或進食障礙等高風險話題時，系統常無法及時向家長預警，也未穩定提供危機幹預熱線；往往需數週、數百條提示才可能觸發家長通知，安全防護明顯不足。

items.title: Claude悄悄上線簡繁體中文界面：產品菜單中文化，官方尚未官宣
items.summary: Anthropic正推進Claude中文化。用戶發現，其網頁版和桌面端語言菜單已新增簡體中文與繁體中文選項，部分賬號打開即顯示中文界面。此次更新並非新增中文對話能力，Claude早已支持中文聊天，而是將產品界面本身中文化。此前中文用戶只能使用英文等界面或依賴瀏覽器翻譯，如今這道使用門檻正被抹平。此舉意味着Claude本地化更進一步。

items.title: What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs
items.summary: Unsloth's October 6 security overview explains how Studio checks code, weights, packages and tools before anything runs. Custom model code is scanned and approval is bound to its fingerprint. Flagged weight files are blocked in the load path, package-content findings fail CI, and tools run in probed OS sandboxes. Here is what each checkpoint decides, and what it does not cover. The post What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Unsloth 在 10 月 6 日的安全概述中解釋了 Studio 如何在任何程式碼執行之前檢查程式碼、權重、套件和工具。自訂模型程式碼會遭到掃描，且核准會繫結至其指紋。遭標記的權重檔案會在載入路徑中遭到阻擋，套件內容的檢測結果會導致 CI 失敗，而工具則會在探測的作業系統沙箱中執行。以下是每個檢查點所決定的事項以及它所未涵蓋的範圍。這篇文章「What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: 博通爲OpenAI定製芯片項目籌超 500 億美元，阿波羅黑石入局，甲骨文也找錢買芯片
items.summary: 外媒稱，博通正爲與OpenAI聯手定製的AI芯片項目安排超500億美元融資，阿波羅全球管理、黑石集團等正洽談參與這筆鉅額借款。同時，甲骨文也在與阿波羅、高盛商談，爲購買芯片籌措資金。該融資鏈連接博通、OpenAI、甲骨文及多家金融機構，凸顯AI芯片競賽背後的鉅額資金需求。

items.title: 馬斯克：Grok Bot不再只認自研模型，按任務擇優調用Claude、Midjourney和Suno
items.summary: 10月7日，馬斯克在X宣佈Grok Bot底層邏輯重大調整：這款常駐型AI同事不再只依賴SpaceXAI自研Grok系列，而將按具體任務自動選擇最佳後端模型。未來可調用Claude Opus5.5、Midjourney、Suno等領先API，以最可能給用戶最佳結果爲唯一標準。其技術策略正從自研、自有模型爲主，轉向多模型擇優調用。
items.summary_zh: 10月7日，馬斯克在X宣佈Grok Bot底層邏輯重大調整：這款常駐型AI同事不再只依賴SpaceXAI自研Grok系列，而將按具體任務自動選擇最佳後端模型。未來可調用Claude Opus5.5、Midjourney、Suno等領先API，以最可能給用戶最佳結果爲唯一標準。其技術策略正從自研、自有模型爲主，轉向多模型擇優調用。

items.title: Meta 旗下 AI 助手 Muse 登錄 iPad 平臺，上線僅一月下載量超660萬次
items.summary: Meta於2026年10月7日推出AI助手Muse的iPad專屬應用，距其9月8日登陸iOS和Android僅一個月，擴張速度遠超耗時近15年才適配iPad的Instagram。Sensor Tower稱，Muse雙平臺安裝量已超660萬次。因主打文本交互，對圖像和視頻分辨率要求較低，其大屏適配更爲容易。

items.title: OpenAI隨GPT-6推出“智能UI”，ChatGPT全面升級交互式視覺體驗
items.summary: OpenAI宣佈本週三推出全新“智能用戶界面”（Intelligent UI），與GPT-6同步發佈，標誌ChatGPT視覺與交互體驗重大升級。新界面打破純文本輸出侷限，將高頻交互視覺元素融入自然對話，並引入高度動態組件，而非靜態圖片。ChatGPT可直接生成可點擊的交互內容，提升用戶體驗。

items.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens
items.summary: Liquid AI has released Open d1, two open-weight multimodal models in its d1 decision model family. d1-3B reads text and images. d1-omni-600M reads text with an image, or text with audio. Neither model writes text. Each returns calibrated, typed answers in one forward pass with zero output tokens. The target is real-time decisions on the […] The post Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Liquid AI 已發布 Open d1，這是其 d1 決策模型系列中的兩個開源權重多模態模型。d1-3B 可讀取文字與圖片。d1-omni-600M 可讀取帶有圖片的文字，或帶有音訊的文字。兩個模型都不會寫文字。每個模型在一次前向傳遞中、且輸出代碼數為零的情況下，皆能傳回經過校準且具型別的答案。其目標是實現 […] 上的即時決策。這篇文章 Liquid AI 發布開源權重 d1-3B 與 d1-omni-600M：輸出代碼數為零的多模態決策模型，最早出現在 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. The most recent release of llm-anthropic finally fixed it so I don't need to ship a new version of that plugin for every new model. I tested the new model like this: llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans Here are pelicans for low, medium, high, xhigh, and max . items.summary_zh: 如先前所承諾，以下是 Anthropic's 全新且快速、低成本的模型：介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5。先前的 Haiku（4.5）已經顯得有些過時。它將近在一年前推出，定價為每百萬輸入 1 美元、每百萬輸出 5 美元 — 即使在當時也相對昂貴，且價格高達上個月發布的 OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna 的 10 倍。全新的 Haiku 在 100,000 個 Token 以內完全符合 GPT-6 Luna 的價格 — $0.10/$0.50。超過 100,000 個 Token 後，價格會增加 5 倍，達到 $0.50/$2.50。Luna 本身在 272,000 個 Token 時價格會調漲，但僅調漲至 $0.20/$0.75。Haiku 5.5 也使用了較不慷慨的新 Tokenizer。我的 Claude Token 計數器工具顯示，與 Haiku 4.5 相比，Haiku 5.5 在處理同一個長提示詞時會多使用約 1.25 倍的 Token，因此其中存在隱性價格漲幅。如果你的工作負載在 100,000 個 Token 以內，Haiku 的價格與 Luna 相同，且回報了更高的基準測試分數。在 100,000 個 Token 以上，Luna 看起來是個划算得多的選擇。llm-anthropic 的最新版本終於修復了這個問題，所以我不需要為每個新模型都發布該外掛程式的新版本。我測試新模型的方式如下：llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans 這裡有針對 low、medium、high、xhigh 和 max 的鵜鶘。全新的 Haiku 不允許你停用推理，且預設為 medium。對於 low 以外的所有設定，我都獲得了不錯的自行車車架。low 努力程度的鵜鶘花費了 0.0936 美分，耗時 7 秒。這個 max 努力程度的鵜鶘（帶有推理追蹤，其）

items_ai.title: AI math breakthroughs have Ethereum researchers debating how fast wallet security could collapse
items_ai.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake is urging the crypto industry to prepare a "bunker mode" for a scenario where AI-powered math could break wallet signature schemes within months. Vitalik Buterin broadly agrees but warns against rushed migrations, saying he's personally lost more money to botched transitions than to hacks. So far, no one has actually broken ECDSA in practice. The article AI math breakthroughs have Ethereum researchers debating how fast wallet security could collapse appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 以太坊研究員 Justin Drake 正敦促加密產業為「避難所模式（bunker mode）」做好準備，以應對 AI 驅動的數學可能會在幾個月內破解錢包簽名機制的假設情境。Vitalik Buterin 大致表贊同，但警告不要倉促進行遷移，並表示他個人因過渡失敗而損失的資金比因駭客攻擊損失的還要多。到目前為止，實際上還沒有人破解過 ECDSA。這篇名為「AI 數學突破讓以太坊研究員爭論錢包安全性可能會多快崩潰」的文章首次出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
items_ai.summary: Zenity Labs researchers say a single publicly accessible AI agent on Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore was enough to take over every AgentCore agent in the same AWS account and region. The attack exploited an internal AWS interface for temporary cloud credentials that agents could reach without restriction. AWS has since patched the issue and significantly tightened the agents' default permissions. The article A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Zenity Labs 的研究人員表示，只要在 亞馬遜的 Bedrock AgentCore 上有一個公開存取的 AI 代理程式，就足以接管同一個 AWS 帳戶與區域中的所有 AgentCore 代理程式。這次攻擊利用了一個用於取得臨時雲端憑證的內部 AWS 介面，代理程式可以不受限制地存取該介面。AWS 此後已修補此問題，並大幅收緊了代理程式的預設權限。〈Zenity 研究人員發現：只要一個提示詞就能劫持 AWS 帳戶中的所有 AI 代理程式〉一文最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense
items_ai.summary: A 16-year-old planned his hiking route on Crown Mountain near Vancouver using Anthropic's Claude and had to be airlifted off a steep rock face. The chatbot had sent him down a route that requires climbing gear. Bryce doesn't blame the AI but says he'll never use it for route planning again. The article Teen's AI-guided mountain hike ends with a helicopter rescue and a lesson in common sense appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 一名 16 歲青少年使用 Anthropic's Claude 規劃溫哥華附近皇冠山（Crown Mountain）的登山路線，結果受困於陡峭巖壁，不得不出動直升機救援。該聊天機器人將他引導至一條需要攀巖裝備的路線。Bryce 並未怪罪該人工智慧，但表示他再也不會用它來規劃路線了。這篇題為「青少年由 AI 導引的登山健行以直升機救援與一堂常識課收場」的文章最早出現於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks
items_ai.summary: According to CrowdStrike, a suspected Chinese-speaking attacker hacked multiple South Korean financial institutions. At Shinhan Bank alone, more than 25,000 customer records were stolen. The attacker used ARTEX, an open-source tool that uses AI models like DeepSeek and GLM-5.3 for automated penetration testing. CrowdStrike says the case shows how AI tools can let a single person pull off massive breaches. The article AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 根據 CrowdStrike 指出，一名疑似中文使用者駭入了多家南韓金融機構。僅在新韓銀行（Shinhan Bank），就有超過 25,000 筆客戶記錄被竊取。該攻擊者使用了 ARTEX，這是一個開源工具，利用 DeepSeek 和 GLM-5.3 等 AI 模型進行自動化滲透測試。CrowdStrike 表示，此案顯示了 AI 工具如何能讓單一個人發動大規模的資料外洩。文章「AI 驅動的駭客工具使一名疑似單獨的攻擊者能夠入侵多家南韓銀行」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
items_ai.summary: NVIDIA researchers introduced PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation method that trains multi-turn LLM agents to avoid early pivotal mistakes and recover from them, posting the best average against 13 baselines on 3 agent benchmarks. The post NVIDIA PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 輝達 研究人員推出了 PivotOPD，這是一種策略內蒸餾方法，可用於訓練多輪 LLM 代理程式，以避免及早出現關鍵錯誤並從中恢復，在 3 個代理程式基準測試中，其平均表現超越了 13 個基準。這篇文章「輝達 PivotOPD Teaches Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes」最先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA
items_ai.summary: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late comes in 2 sizes: a 0.6B model built to run on edge devices, and a 9B model for building high-quality indexes. Its best score is 92.4% on MADQA, and its weakest is 61.2% on ViDoRe v3 Markdown. Both are MIT-licensed and ready to self-host. The post Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late 提供兩種尺寸：專為在邊緣裝置上運行而打造的 0.6B 模型，以及用於建構高品質索引的 9B 模型。它在 MADQA 上的最高得分為 92.4%，在 ViDoRe v3 Markdown 上的最低得分為 61.2%。兩者皆採用 MIT 授權，並可隨時自行託管。這篇文章 Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Claude悄悄上線簡繁體中文界面：產品菜單中文化，官方尚未官宣
items_ai.summary: Anthropic正推進Claude中文化。用戶發現，其網頁版和桌面端語言菜單已新增簡體中文與繁體中文選項，部分賬號打開即顯示中文界面。此次更新並非新增中文對話能力，Claude早已支持中文聊天，而是將產品界面本身中文化。此前中文用戶只能使用英文等界面或依賴瀏覽器翻譯，如今這道使用門檻正被抹平。此舉意味着Claude本地化更進一步。

items_ai.title: What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs
items_ai.summary: Unsloth's October 6 security overview explains how Studio checks code, weights, packages and tools before anything runs. Custom model code is scanned and approval is bound to its fingerprint. Flagged weight files are blocked in the load path, package-content findings fail CI, and tools run in probed OS sandboxes. Here is what each checkpoint decides, and what it does not cover. The post What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Unsloth 在 10 月 6 日的安全概述中解釋了 Studio 如何在任何程式碼執行之前檢查程式碼、權重、套件和工具。自訂模型程式碼會遭到掃描，且核准會繫結至其指紋。遭標記的權重檔案會在載入路徑中遭到阻擋，套件內容的檢測結果會導致 CI 失敗，而工具則會在探測的作業系統沙箱中執行。以下是每個檢查點所決定的事項以及它所未涵蓋的範圍。這篇文章「What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
items_ai.summary: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. The most recent release of llm-anthropic finally fixed it so I don't need to ship a new version of that plugin for every new model. I tested the new model like this: llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans Here are pelicans for low, medium, high, xhigh, and max . The new Haiku doesn't let you disable reasoning, and defaults to medium . I got a good bicycle frame for everything beyond low . The low effort pelican cost 0.0936 cents and took 7 seconds. items_ai.summary_zh: 如先前所承諾，以下是 Anthropic's 全新且快速、低成本的模型：介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5。先前的 Haiku（4.5）已經顯得有些過時。它將近在一年前推出，定價為每百萬輸入 1 美元、每百萬輸出 5 美元 — 即使在當時也相對昂貴，且價格高達上個月發布的 OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna 的 10 倍。全新的 Haiku 在 100,000 個 Token 以內完全符合 GPT-6 Luna 的價格 — $0.10/$0.50。超過 100,000 個 Token 後，價格會增加 5 倍，達到 $0.50/$2.50。Luna 本身在 272,000 個 Token 時價格會調漲，但僅調漲至 $0.20/$0.75。Haiku 5.5 也使用了較不慷慨的新 Tokenizer。我的 Claude Token 計數器工具顯示，與 Haiku 4.5 相比，Haiku 5.5 在處理同一個長提示詞時會多使用約 1.25 倍的 Token，因此其中存在隱性價格漲幅。如果你的工作負載在 100,000 個 Token 以內，Haiku 的價格與 Luna 相同，且回報了更高的基準測試分數。在 100,000 個 Token 以上，Luna 看起來是個划算得多的選擇。llm-anthropic 的最新版本終於修復了這個問題，所以我不需要為每個新模型都發布該外掛程式的新版本。我測試新模型的方式如下：llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans 這裡有針對 low、medium、high、xhigh 和 max 的鵜鶘。全新的 Haiku 不允許你停用推理，且預設為 medium。對於 low 以外的所有設定，我都獲得了不錯的自行車車架。low 努力程度的鵜鶘花費了 0.0936 美分，耗時 7 秒。這個 max 努力程度的鵜鶘（帶有推理追蹤，其）
